_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Service Action Support Report
summary: The Service Action Support Report documents and tracks Service Actions released by the FAA and aircraft, subsystem, and component manufacturers, providing summary information to help determine SA incorporation and plan logistic implementation.
use_relationship:
The Service Action Support Report is used to document and track Service Actions (SAs) released by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and aircraft, subsystem, and component manufacturers, respectively.

This report provides summary information on each issued SA to help determine whether or not SAs will be incorporated on the aircraft and define the plan for the logistic implementation of those SAs.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and preparation instructions for the data product resulting from the work task specified in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Title Page
children.content: The Report shall contain a title page identifying the following:

children.title: Signature block(s) showing corporate release approval
Abstract
children.content: The Report shall contain an abstract defining the purpose and use of the report in support of the program.

children.title: Contents
children.content: The Report shall contain the following information for each Service Action:

children.title: Air Transport Association (ATA) Chapter associated with each SA
List of aircraft affected by each SA (aircraft effectivity)
Service Action Review Board (SARB) disposition history of previous revisions of each SA
Incorporation history by aircraft tail number for previous revisions of each SA
Contractor implementation recommendations for each SA
